qe: If every alternative letter starting from B is deleted then which letter will be 5th to the right of 4th from the left end?
qh: यदि B से शुरू करते हुए प्रत्येक एकांतर (alternative) अक्षर को हटा दिया जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से चौथे अक्षर के दाएँ 5वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Odd Series $(2n - 1)$ Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: B se shuru karke alternative letters (B, D, F, ...) hatane par visham sthanon (odd positions) wale letters bachenge:
$$\text{Series}: \text{A, C, E, G, I, K, M, O, Q, S, U, W, Y (kul 13 letters)}$$
Step 2: Position from Left end calculate karein (Opposite directions = Addition):
$$\text{Position from Left} = 4 + 5 = 9\text{th letter}$$
Step 3: Odd series me baayein se $n$-th letter ki real alphabetical position $(2n - 1)$ hoti hai:
$$\text{Original Position} = (9 $\times$ 2) - 1 = 18 - 1 = 17$$
Standard alphabet me 17वाँ letter 'Q' hota hai.
Correct option  Q hai.

Method 2 (Manual Counting Method):
Odd series: A(1), C(2), E(3), G(4), I(5), K(6), M(7), O(8), Q(9).
Baayein se 9th sthan par aane wala letter 'Q' hai.
Sahi uttar 'Q' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If every alternative letter starting from B is deleted then which letter will be 5th to the left of 12th from the left end?
qh: यदि B से शुरू करते हुए प्रत्येक एकांतर अक्षर को हटा दिया जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से 12वें अक्षर के बाएँ 5वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Odd Series $(2n - 1)$ Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Samaan dishaon (Left aur Left) ke liye ghataav (subtraction) karein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 12 - 5 = 7\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Odd series me original position nikalne ka formula $(2n - 1)$ lagayein:
$$\text{Original Position} = (7 $\times$ 2) - 1 = 14 - 1 = 13$$
13वाँ letter 'M' hota hai.
Correct option  M hai.

Method 2 (Direct Odd Sequence Counting):
Odd series: A(1), C(2), E(3), G(4), I(5), K(6), M(7).
7th position par letter 'M' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'M' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If every alternative letter starting from B is deleted then which letter will be 3rd to the left of 7th from the right end?
qh: यदि B से शुरू करते हुए प्रत्येक एकांतर अक्षर को हटा दिया जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 7वें अक्षर के बाएँ तीसरा अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Odd Series Right-to-Left Conversion Shortcut):
Step 1: Position from Right end nikalein (Right + Left):
$$\text{Position from Right} = 7 + 3 = 10\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Odd series me kul 13 letters hote hain, isliye Left end me convert karne ke liye $(13 + 1) = 14$ me se ghataayein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 14 - 10 = 4\text{th letter}$$
Step 3: Original alphabetical position ke liye $(2n - 1)$ apply karein:
$$\text{Original Position} = (4 $\times$ 2) - 1 = 8 - 1 = 7$$
7वाँ letter 'G' hota hai.
Correct option  G hai.

Method 2 (Direct Backward Counting Method):
Odd series daayein se: Y(1), W(2), U(3), S(4), Q(5), O(6), M(7), K(8), I(9), G(10).
Daayein छोर se 10वाँ letter 'G' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'G' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If every alternative letter starting from B is deleted then which letter will be 6th to the right of 12th from the right end?
qh: यदि B से शुरू करते हुए प्रत्येक एकांतर अक्षर को हटा दिया जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 12वें अक्षर के दाएँ छठा अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Odd Series Conversion Shortcut):
Step 1: Samaan dishaon (Right aur Right) ke liye ghataayein:
$$\text{Position from Right} = 12 - 6 = 6\text{th letter}$$
Step 2: Total 13 letters hone ke karan Left end me badlein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = (13 + 1) - 6 = 14 - 6 = 8\text{th letter}$$
Step 3: Formula $(2n - 1)$ se original alphabet position nikalein:
$$\text{Original Position} = (8 $\times$ 2) - 1 = 16 - 1 = 15$$
15वाँ letter 'O' hota hai.
Correct option  O hai.

Method 2 (Right End Inspection Method):
Odd series piche se: Y(1), W(2), U(3), S(4), Q(5), O(6).
Daayein chhor se 6th sthan par letter 'O' aata hai.
Sahi uttar 'O' hai.

Exam point: diye gaye tathyon ka sahi milan - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
